thread_text:
Aisha (PM): folks 07dropping a proposal for the cutover playbook + pricing anchor for migration concierge customers. want short answers: is this feasible and what are hard blockers?

Marco (Eng Manager): overall feasible. main infra risk is cross-region KV-cache invalidation during variant switch. need a deterministic cache-miss plan.

Priya (CS): customers prioritize predictable dates and a rollback SLA. they asked for a 72-hour rollback window in contracts. can legal accept?

Omar (Security): we need an approval step for residency-sensitive tenants: must verify KMS boundaries and audit log retention before cutover. add to checklist.

Yuki (SRE): launch gating essentials:
- dry-run with synthetic traffic for 6 hours
- staggered ramp (5% -> 25% -> 100%) over at least 12 hours
- automated rollback on error-rate OR model-quality regression
Also want a per-tenant "panic switch" flag.

Aisha (PM): pricing anchor idea: migration concierge = fixed 2-week support + SE time + infra lead; charge a flat onboarding fee + 3 months discounted rate. Leah, thoughts?

Leah (Sales): sounds good. recommend a tiered fee: Small, Mid, Enterprise. enterprise gets guaranteed cutover weekend slots and on-call SE. we should phrase as "migration assistance" in contract.

Marco (Eng Manager): technical note: routing policy must include a fallback TTL policy so we don't route to a warm-but-incompatible variant. sample DSL snippet:```policy {
  tenant: "T123"
  route_priority: [region, model_family, quant]
  fallback_ttl_secs: 300
  pin_to_variant: null
}```

Priya (CS): +1 for rollback SLA but customers will want extended audit trails. can we retain pre-cutover request logs for 30 days for audit?

Omar (Security): 30 days ok for most, but enterprise with regs may need configurable retention. document opt-in. also verify data residency of logs.

Yuki (SRE): ops checklist (short):
1) confirm reserve capacity and preprovision_window_minutes
2) run synthetic smoke and monitor: latency p95, error rate, model failures
3) confirm telemetry (routing_reason) is enabled
4) perform staged ramp and observe quality signals
5) finalize cutover and enable post-cutover monitoring runbook

Aisha (PM): success metrics to commit to product signoff:
- two pilot tenants complete staged ramp with SLOs (p95 latency, error rate) met for 24h
- model quality regression < 2% on tenant holdout set
- runbook exercised once in staging with rollback

Leah (Sales): we should include a cancellation clause: if rollback happens within 72h due to platform error, provide pro-rated credit. keeps customers comfortable.

Marco (Eng Manager): last technical ask: emergency pin API + immutable rollout_id must exist. ops needs to be able to pin variant and revert by rollout_id.

Aisha (PM): next actions:
- Marco/Yuki: produce minimal playbook + emergency API doc by Thu EOD
- Priya/Leah: draft customer-facing migration package + pricing tiers by Fri
- Omar: residency & logs guidance doc by Mon
- deploy-bot: create RFC stub https://redwood/team/rfc/migration-concierge (product, infra, security)

deploy-bot: created RFC https://redwood/team/rfc/migration-concierge :white_check_mark:

Aisha (PM): thanks all. if you cantake an action, drop a quick "i got it" below. :rocket:
